title: Split Cosmic Realms
description: A surreal split-composition artwork shows a large dual-faced figure divided vertically between light and dark. The left white side features a female profile with a hat, third eye, and purple mountain orb held in hand, set against a bright starry sky with geometric shapes and flowers. The right black side displays a skeletal male profile with multiple red and black eyes, set against a dark space with comets and a small astronaut standing on the red-and-white cratered foreground surface between black and white flowers.
prompt: Surreal vertically split artwork with a large androgynous figure, left side white with a woman's profile wearing a hat and third eye, holding a purple mountain orb, bright sky with geometric constellations and white flowers below. Right side black with a skeletal male profile having multiple red eyes, dark space with comets and stars. Small astronaut in a spacesuit stands centered on a cratered moon surface half white half red, surrounded by black and white flowers, intricate black line art with purple accents.
